**Use case:** The task you want to complete and what currently blocks it. Redact private information.

**Smallest improvement:** A proposed change, alternatives considered, and how it preserves the default install and simple local customization.

**Evidence:** For host support, include OS and harness versions, current official documentation, and any reproducible discovery or lifecycle result. Mark untested behavior explicitly.

Requests and contributions are welcome; the project makes no implementation or response-time promise.
